title: Prolific reviewers
statementMd:
Find reviewers who have written **at least 6** reviews.

Expected columns: `reviewer`, `review_count`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT reviewer, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM reviews GROUP BY reviewer HAVING COUNT(*) >= 6;
```

`HAVING` filters after aggregation, so it can reference `COUNT(*)`.

expected.query: SELECT reviewer, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM reviews GROUP BY reviewer HAVING COUNT(*) >= 6;
